input: Find football, wrestling, track and cross-country camps for youth for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: A.C. Reynolds High School
candidates.note: Youth summer sports camps include football; recommended for kindergarten through eighth grade.

candidates.name: ProSportPlex
candidates.note: Rico Dowdle youth football camp at A.C. Reynolds High School, ages 6–17; held June 20, 2026.

candidates.name: T.C. Roberson High School
candidates.note: 2026 morning football and wrestling camps; wrestling served rising first–ninth graders.

candidates.name: North Buncombe High School
candidates.note: June 2026 youth football camp taught by high-school coaches and players.

candidates.name: Enka High School
candidates.note: WNC Elite Wrestling Camp ran in 2026 and accepts all ages and experience levels.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Municipal summer programs include a wrestling camp for ages 10–14; 2027 schedules are due February 1.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike Smoky Mountain Running Camp at UNC Asheville for ages 11–17; July 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: All-American Cross Country Camp
candidates.note: Cross-country running camp on the Christ School campus; three July 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Brevard Distance Runners Camp
candidates.note: Summer distance-running camp; a July 5–11, 2026 session was listed.

candidates.name: P.R. Running Camp
candidates.note: Middle- and high-school running camp at Western Carolina University; two July 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Carolinas Fellowship of Christian Athletes
candidates.note: Western NC team football camp at Mars Hill University, June 11–13, 2026.
